title: Why AI Stocks Are Falling (It’s Worse Than You Think)
creator: Asymmetric Investing
summary: Travis Hoium (Asymmetric Investing) argues the AI sell-off is a financing reckoning centred on the neoclouds — CoreWeave, Nebius and Iren, with Oracle grouped in. Over five days to Friday's recording Oracle fell about 9%, Nebius about 19%, and Iren and CoreWeave about 22%. His three drivers: first, Anthropic's revenue growth has stalled month-on-month (about +1.8% over four weeks, after +46% quarter-on-quarter in Q3), while the capex already committed needs AI revenue to reach about $3 trillion by 2031 — Dylan Patel's framing, quoted in the video, is that OpenAI and Anthropic alone must reach hundreds of billions by end-2027 or 'we're in real trouble'. Second, buyers are capping AI spend (Accenture's $29-a-month Claude limit; Uber, Meta and Microsoft ending unlimited 'token maxing'), so willingness to pay, not token demand, is the question. Third, CoreWeave's 9% February 2031 debt yield has risen from about 8% in May to over 15%, implying a 20–25% equity hurdle that makes new data centres unprofitable — a doom loop for names that must keep raising capital, while cash-generative hyperscalers can pause. He is not in this part of the trade and expects more collapses. Calls: CRWV, NBIS, IREN and ORCL — AVOID (CRWV and ORCL were SELL on his 29 Sep sell list, so this is a stance change in form, with the bearish thesis unchanged); GOOGL — HOLD (owned, 'going to be just fine', no price stated). Caption figures for Patel's revenue projections are garbled in places.

calls.thesis: CoreWeave is the worked example: at a ~15% debt yield the equity return hurdle is 20-25%, which he thinks makes its buildout unprofitable. Neocloud doom loop: Anthropic revenue growth has stalled month-on-month (~+1.8% over the past 4 weeks after +46% QoQ in Q3), corporate AI spend is being capped, and CoreWeave's 2031 debt yield has risen from ~8% in May to over 15%, so new capital is too expensive to build data centres profitably; he is not in this part of the AI trade and expects some of these stocks to keep collapsing.
